meta.description: The Equity Atlas: A hierarchical universe of stock tickers, sector groupings, and identity metadata used to acquire market physics and structured proxy matrices.

data.__doc:
[PURPOSE]
This file, "The Equity Atlas," is a static configuration resource.
It defines the hierarchical universe of stock tickers, sector groupings, and identity metadata.
Used by tools/stock/stock.py to fetch prices and metrics.
[INTERFACE]
1. config: Fetching parameters (snapshot_period, etc).
2. universe: Nested taxonomy of tickers.
3. defaults: Fallback values.
